title: Erbium-doped fiber of the spectral model of Giles and Desurvire (1991), Table II fiber (alumino-silicate)
model: Not used by any reference model of this review. Stored only to document the parameter-mixing example of Section 5.2 (Figure 10d), in which this value was combined by mistake with card EDFA-GD91-T1.
notes: The source describes two different fibers: the high-efficiency fiber of its spatial model (Table I, Figs. 4-5; card EDFA-GD91-T1) and the fiber of its spectral model (Table II, Figs. 6-7), which the source describes as having a higher pump threshold. Category 'measured' follows the convention of card EDFA-GD91-T1: the value is reported by the source for this fiber; whether it was measured or derived in the source is to be confirmed in [41].

xi.applies_to: Table II fiber of [41] (spectral model, Figs. 6 and 7 of the source); NOT the Table I fiber of card EDFA-GD91-T1, for which the source gives 1.5e15 (Sec. VI)

verification.note: value and unit checked against a text (OCR) copy of the source; the authors confirm the table column in the version of record
